newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - ATI seen as long-term buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ATI seen as long-term buy.

text.p: Manila brokerage Anscor Hagedorn Securities on Friday recommended a long-term buy for port operator Asian Terminals Inc.
Analyst April Bautista said the company's net income was expected to reach 350 million pesos this year on the back of rising cargo traffic.
The company earlier reported net income of 84.89 million pesos for the third quarter this year, up 39.5 percent year on year.
Bautista added that the inland container depot, which is expected to raise its cargo handling capability, is expected to start operations in November, one month ahead of schedule.
The operation of its grains terminal is also likely to boost its bottom line this year, he said.
